dinners.name: Salmon, Edamame + Roasted Broccoli
dinners.note: Same dish — Jake gets a larger salmon portion.

ingredients.item: Soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, sesame seeds

steps: Toss broccoli with olive oil, salt, garlic. Roast at 425F / 220C for 20 min.
Season both salmon portions with soy sauce + sesame oil. Pan-sear 4 min per side.
Microwave edamame per package. Toss with sesame oil + pinch of salt.
Plate separately by portion size.

dinners.name: Turkey Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Brown all turkey in one pan with spices. Add beans + tomatoes. Cook 5 min.
Fill Jake's 4 pepper halves generously, Laine's 2 halves modestly.
Top with cheese. Bake 20 min at 400F / 200C.

dinners.name: Steak, White Bean Mash + Asparagus
dinners.note: Jake gets larger steak. Laine gets more bean mash for carbs.
steps: Warm beans with garlic + olive oil. Mash roughly. Season with lemon + salt.
Roast asparagus with oil + salt at 425F / 220C for 12 min.
Sear steaks in a hot cast-iron — Jake 3-4 min per side, Laine 2-3 min. Rest 5 min.

dinners.name: Shrimp + Chickpea Stir-Fry
dinners.note: Same sauce and veggies — Jake gets more shrimp.

ingredients.item: Mixed veggies (bell pepper, snap peas, bok choy)

steps: Mix sauce: soy sauce, sesame oil, sriracha, ginger. Set aside.
Saute garlic. Add chickpeas 3 min. Add veggies 3 min. Add all shrimp, cook 2 min per side.
Portion shrimp by weight, pour sauce over, toss, serve immediately.

dinners.name: Baked Cod + Lemon Lentil Soup
dinners.note: More soup for Laine (carbs), more cod for Jake.
steps: Saute onion, carrot, celery in olive oil 5 min. Add spices, stir 1 min.
Add lentils, tomatoes, and 3 cups water. Simmer 20 min. Finish with lemon.
Season cod with salt, pepper, lemon zest. Bake at 400F / 200C for 12-14 min.
Laine gets larger bowl of soup + smaller cod. Jake gets smaller soup + larger cod.

dinners.name: Chicken Thighs, Sweet Potato + Kale
dinners.note: One sheet pan. Laine gets more sweet potato, Jake more chicken.

ingredients.item: Garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, lemon

steps: Toss sweet potato with oil, smoked paprika, salt. Roast at 410F / 210C for 25 min.
Season chicken with garlic powder, cumin, salt. Add to sheet pan for last 20 min.
Massage kale with a little oil + salt. Add to pan for final 5 min.
Portion chicken by weight. Laine gets more potato.

dinners.name: Pork Tenderloin, Brussels Sprouts + Lentils
dinners.note: While this cooks — prep both weekday lunch batches.

ingredients.item: Dijon mustard, garlic, thyme, salt, pepper, lemon

steps: Cook lentils: simmer in salted water 20 min. Drain, dress with olive oil + lemon.
Rub pork with Dijon, garlic, thyme, salt + pepper. Sear 2 min per side.
Toss Brussels sprouts with oil, salt, pepper. Arrange around pork on the pan.
Roast at 410F / 210C for 18-20 min until pork hits 145F / 63C. Rest 5 min. Portion by weight.

jakeLunch.name: Turkish-Style Lentil + Chicken Bowl
jakeLunch.note: Make the full batch below, then divide into 5 equal containers. Grab one each day Mon–Fri. Reheat 2 min — add a splash of water to the lentils first.

ingredients.imperial: 2 cans (15 oz each) black beans, drained
10 oz / about 8 big handfuls fresh spinach

ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp turmeric
steps: Season chicken with cumin, paprika, salt + pepper. Bake at 400F / 200C for 25 min. Cool and shred. This is your protein for all 5 containers.
Rinse lentils. Simmer in 3.5 cups (900ml) water with turmeric + crushed garlic for 15 min until soft. They thicken as they cool — that's normal.
In a large pan, saute zucchini in olive oil 5 min. Add black beans, warm through. Add all the spinach, toss until wilted.
Divide everything evenly across 5 containers: lentils on the bottom, veggie/bean mix in the middle, shredded chicken on top.
Squeeze lemon over each container. Pack Greek yogurt separately if using — mix in right before eating.

laineLunch.name: Chicken, Rice + Roasted Veggie Bowl
laineLunch.note: Make the full batch below, then divide into 5 equal containers. Higher carb, lower fat to match Laine's macros. Keeps all week in the fridge.

ingredients.imperial: 1.5 cups dry basmati or jasmine rice

ingredients: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder, paprika, salt
steps: Cook rice per package. Fluff and season lightly with salt. This is the base for all 5 containers.
Season chicken breast with spices. Bake at 400F / 200C for 22 min. Cool and slice.
Toss zucchini, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and chickpeas with olive oil + salt. Roast at 410F / 210C for 20 min.
Divide evenly across 5 containers: rice on the bottom, roasted veggie mix in the middle, sliced chicken on top.
Squeeze lemon over each container, top with parsley. Seal and refrigerate.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Layer yogurt in a bowl or jar.
Top with berries, granola, flaxseed, and a drizzle of honey.
Tip: prep the night before in a jar — just add granola in the morning so it stays crunchy.

laineBreakfasts.name: Egg White Scramble + Toast
steps: Saute bell pepper in olive oil 2 min. Add spinach, wilt 1 min.
Add eggs. Scramble gently over medium-low heat until just set.
Serve with toast.

laineBreakfasts.name: Banana Oat Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend banana, oats, eggs, protein powder, and cinnamon until smooth.
Cook small pancakes on a non-stick pan over medium heat, 2 min per side.
Top with fresh fruit and a drizzle of honey.

jakeSnacks.name: Cottage Cheese + Walnuts
jakeSnacks.desc: 3/4 cup full-fat cottage cheese + a small handful of walnuts. No prep.

jakeSnacks.name: Hard-Boiled Eggs + Avocado
jakeSnacks.desc: 2 hard-boiled eggs + 1/2 avocado, salt + chili flakes.

jakeSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Flaxseed
jakeSnacks.desc: 3/4 cup 0% Greek yogurt + 1 tbsp ground flaxseed.

jakeSnacks.name: Edamame
jakeSnacks.desc: About 1.5 cups shelled edamame, microwaved, sea salt.

Cans + Dry: Black beans x 3 cans (15 oz each)
White cannellini beans x 2 cans (15 oz each)

Cans + Dry.imperial: Basmati or jasmine rice 1.5 cups dry

Produce: Mixed berries — fresh or 1 frozen bag
